title: Best Spanish Tapas Outside Spain (in North Carolina!)
description:
Welcome to Curate, an acclaimed Spanish tapas bar located in Downtown Asheville, North Carolina. This establishment offers authentic Spanish flavors, making it one of the best tapas experiences outside of Spain. Join us for a culinary journey in the heart of the Blue Ridge Mountains, exploring what makes this a must-visit among Asheville things to do.
